issues.description: Helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal): the problem statement explicitly instructs students to implement the helper as public ("make sure to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public"), but the template declares a private helper with the Animal parameter commented out (template: private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)) and the reference solution declares it as private (solution: private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)). This mismatch between the documented required visibility (public) and both template and solution (private) will confuse students and test harnesses that expect to call the helper directly for testing.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method signature public and accept an Animal parameter in both template and solution to match the problem statement. Change the signature to: public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). Update the template implementation (uncomment/add the parameter) and the solution helper visibility to public so tests and students can access the helper as described.
